name: ARC-Roller
description: Motorized inline skates with magnetic-assist wheels. Originally a military prototype for rapid infantry movement, the design leaked and cheap knockoffs flooded Tier 1-2 markets within months. The knockoffs lack the stabilization of the original and broken ankles are epidemic. But for a courier who knows how to use them, they're faster than a bike and can go anywhere a person can walk — including stairs, if you're brave.
propulsion: Electric wheel motors, magnetic grip assist
cost: Φ60-300 depending on quality. Military originals: Φ2,000 (if you can find them).
autonomy: Manual control with balance assist (premium models only)
armament: None. They make kicks significantly more dangerous.
common_usage: Couriers, messengers, youth transit, competitive racing.
story_hooks: A courier on ARC-Rollers discovers they can access maintenance tunnels that no vehicle can reach — becoming the fastest messenger in GLMZ
Someone is manufacturing perfect copies of the military-grade Rollers and selling them cheap — too cheap — and the stabilization firmware has a backdoor
